output.question: What are C&S Wholesale Grocers' subsidiaries?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, C&S Wholesale Grocers publicly identifies Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, FreshKo Produce Services, The Davidson Specialty Food Group (also described as Davidson Specialty Foods), and SpartanNash within its family of companies. Piggly Wiggly Midwest also confirms that it operates as part of C&S. Its principal retail banners include Grand Union, Piggly Wiggly, D&W Fresh Market, Family Fare and Martin’s Super Markets; these are store banners, not necessarily separate legal subsidiaries. The Winn-Dixie Company should be treated separately: C&S participated in its acquisition through a consortium, but the proposed transaction making C&S its majority owner was announced on August 13, 2026, with closing expected in early 2027.

key_facts.fact: C&S identifies Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, FreshKo Produce Services, The Davidson Specialty Food Group and SpartanNash as members of its family of companies.
C&S's August 13, 2026 release uses the name Davidson Specialty Foods in its family-of-companies description.
Piggly Wiggly Midwest operates as part of C&S Wholesale Grocers.
C&S identifies D&W Fresh Market, Grand Union, Family Fare, Martin’s Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly as retail banners.

C&S announced a proposed majority-ownership transaction for The Winn-Dixie Company on August 13, 2026, expected to close in early 2027; C&S had previously participated in a consortium acquisition in 2025.
